data.cultural_impact: The name Razan has a rich Arabic origin meaning "one who brings rain." Rain is considered to be a source of life and renewal in Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures. The arrival of rain nourishes the earth, replenishes water sources and brings new growth to agriculture. The name Razan could therefore be interpreted as one who blesses others with the gifts of life and renewal.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Razan holds deep symbolism for the sustenance and nourishment provided by Allah. The rain falling from the sky is seen as a manifestation of Allah's mercy and providence. Razan, therefore, can be considered a reminder of the divine blessings that sustain and support us in life.
